visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a denim jacket, black skirt, and brown boots walks into a motorcycle workshop. She carries a long, silver-colored exhaust pipe under her right arm. The setting is an indoor garage with numerous motorcycles of various colors and models parked in the background under bright fluorescent lighting. (2) The woman approaches a male staff member in a blue and black Yamaha-branded uniform. A mechanic is seen kneeling on the ground next to a white and pink sport motorcycle, holding tools and preparing to work on the exhaust system. The background features shelves filled with equipment and bike tires. (3) The mechanic starts the motorcycle, and the group stands around the rear of the bike to listen. The woman holds her exhaust pipe while a man in a black t-shirt looks at his phone. The camera remains at eye-level, capturing the interactions and the mechanical details of the motorcycle's tail section. (4) The men and the woman react with exaggerated expressions of joy and approval. One man gives a thumbs-up while smiling at the camera. Animated text overlays and variety-show style captions appear on the screen to emphasize the humor and energy of the scene.
